title.en: Life cycles of plants and animals

text.en: Reena and Amit travel to their village near a forest for a harvest festival. On this day their village becomes fully solar-powered.

Reena and Amit go to their village near a forest for a harvest festival. That day their village will be fully solar-powered.
As they enter they see trees full of bright orange-red flowers. Their father says it is a Palash tree. When it blooms the whole forest looks reddish-orange, so Palash is called the flame of the forest.
Palash has local names, like Kesuda in Gujarat. Write names of five colourful flowers in your area and their local names.
Solar panels make electricity from sunlight for fans and bulbs.
Plants and animals grow and change as they go through a life cycle: birth, growth, reproduction and death.
